import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan;

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (!infected[timestamp]) return;
            setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        double length;

        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            length = l;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        ArrayList<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class Graph {
        ArrayList<Node> nodes;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;

        Graph(int n) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) nodes.add(new Node());
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, length));
            nodes.get(from).out.add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] pathCap) {
            double[] cap = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(cap, 0.0);
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            cap[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            PriorityQueue<Pair> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.cap, a.cap));
            pq.add(new Pair(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source));

            while (!pq.isEmpty() && cap[sink] == 0.0) {
                Pair cur = pq.poll();
                double c = cur.cap;
                int v = cur.node;
                if (c < cap[v]) continue;
                for (int eidx : nodes.get(v).out) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eidx);
                    double rem = e.length - flow[eidx];
                    if (rem > 0.0) {
                        double nc = Math.min(c, rem);
                        if (nc > cap[e.to]) {
                            cap[e.to] = nc;
                            pred[e.to] = eidx;
                            pq.add(new Pair(nc, e.to));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            pathCap[0] = cap[sink];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int eidx = pred[sink];
            while (eidx != -1) {
                path.add(eidx);
                eidx = pred[edges.get(eidx).from];
            }
            return path;
        }

        double maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size());
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                residual.addEdge(e.from, e.to, e.length);
                residual.addEdge(e.to, e.from, 0.0);
            }

            double[] flow = new double[residual.edges.size()];
            double[] pathCap = new double[1];
            ArrayList<Integer> path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);

            while (pathCap[0] > 0.0) {
                for (int eidx : path) {
                    int rev = eidx ^ 1;
                    flow[eidx] += pathCap[0];
                    flow[rev] -= pathCap[0];
                }
                path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, pathCap);
            }

            double total = 0.0;
            for (int eidx : residual.nodes.get(source).out) {
                total += flow[eidx];
            }
            return total;
        }

        static class Pair {
            double cap;
            int node;
            Pair(double c, int n) {
                cap = c;
                node = n;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        floorplan = new Room[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                else if (ch == 'Z') floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                else floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        Graph g = new Graph(n * n * (t + 1) + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0 && floorplan[i - 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i - 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && floorplan[i + 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i + 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j - 1].accessible[c]) {
                            g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j - 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && floorplan[i][j + 1].accessible[c]) {
                            g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j + 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) g.maxFlow(0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
